Description
Product Type
The BM08 is a cutting-edge momcozy smart baby monitor . Designed as a next-generation video baby monitor , it goes far beyond a traditional baby monitor camera to act as an AI-powered, contact-free digital assistant for your nursery (Note: NOT A MEDICAL DEVICE and not intended to diagnose medical conditions/SIDS) .
Core Selling Points
Widely praised as a top contender for the best baby monitor , this smart baby monitor is powered by advanced contact-free mmWave sensing to detect baby's motion and generate sleep activity logs without any wearables. It features true AI cry detection that distinguishes real crying from background noise and automatically plays soft white noise to soothe your little one. The 2K HD video offers an 8x digital zoom to see every tiny detail. Late at night, the 940nm invisible infrared LEDs deliver premium, glare-free night vision , illuminating the room in complete darkness without disrupting your baby’s sleep. Data is highly secure with 128-bit AES encryption and dual-band 2.4/5GHz Wi-Fi + Bluetooth support.
Material & Touch
Constructed from eco-friendly, non-toxic, food-grade plastics with a durable, impact-resistant finish. The back of the monitor features an ergonomically molded, anti-slip texture for a secure and comfortable grip.
Target Audience / Use Case
Specially designed for data-driven, modern parents who want contact-free sleep tracking, smart notifications without false alerts, and a rock-solid Wi-Fi connection throughout a large house.
Size & Compatibility
The parent unit adopts a lightweight, pocket-friendly design. The camera features advanced sensor placement and a high-grade lens array that operates perfectly from sunrise to midnight.
Care Instructions
Periodically clean dust from the camera lens using a soft brush or lens cloth to maintain optimal 2K clarity. Keep the unit away from direct moisture, humidifiers, and prolonged direct sunlight.

Contact-Free Monitoring & Sleep Insights
Notifications, Sleep Reports & Soothing
Wi-Fi, Placement & Multi-Camera Use
Privacy, Sharing & Storage
What can BM08 monitor without putting anything on my baby?
BM08 uses contact-free mmWave sensing to provide insights into breathing, heart rate, and sleep patterns. No wearable sensor is required, so your baby can sleep without an attached device.
Is the contact-free monitoring safe? Is BM08 a medical device?
BM08 uses low-power, non-contact sensing. It is not a medical device and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition. Use the monitor as supportive information alongside normal adult supervision and professional medical advice when needed.
What age range is BM08 designed for?
BM08 is designed for babies and toddlers from 0 to 3 years old, covering the newborn stage through the toddler years.
Do I need a subscription to use sleep tracking and monitoring data?
No monthly subscription is required. Core monitoring features, sleep tracking, motion alerts, and vital-sign insights are available in the Momcozy app without a recurring fee.
What notifications can the Momcozy app provide?
The app can notify you about face-covering and roll-over risks, crying, movement, breathing or heart-rate changes, and sleep status such as light sleep, deep sleep, and wake-ups.
What is included in the sleep report?
BM08 summarizes sleep duration, sleep patterns, and sleep segments so you can understand the night at a glance instead of repeatedly checking the live video. Daily summaries and statistics are generated the following morning.
Can BM08 help soothe my baby?
Yes. When crying is detected, the app can send an alert. You can also use auto-play white noise and two-way talk to provide a first response without immediately entering the room.
How clear is the video at night?
BM08 provides 2K HD video, 940nm infrared night vision, and detailed zoom so you can check your baby clearly in both daylight and low-light conditions.
Does BM08 work without Wi-Fi?
The camera requires Wi-Fi to operate and supports both 2.4GHz and 5GHz networks. When you are away from home, your phone can use mobile data to access the camera through the Momcozy app. BM08 does not operate as an offline, standalone camera.
Where should I place the camera for the best monitoring accuracy?
For best results, use the floor stand beside the crib or bassinet, approximately 1 meter (3.3 feet) above your baby’s chest area. Keep the camera safely out of reach and make sure the chest area is visible.
Can I move BM08 between rooms or take it while traveling?
Yes. The compact monitor has a foldable stand and flexible desk or floor setup, making it easy to move between rooms or pack for travel.
Can I use BM08 with twins or two cameras?
One camera is designed to track one baby. For twins, use two cameras. The app lets you switch between cameras, but it does not currently provide split-screen viewing. notifications from the other connected camera can still be delivered even when you are viewing the first camera.
How does BM08 protect my family’s data?
Momcozy uses AES encryption for data transmission, Privacy Mode to pause monitoring when you choose, local-storage support, and primary/guest account permissions so you can control access to the monitor.
Can multiple caregivers use BM08 on different phones?
Yes. One primary account can invite up to four additional sub-accounts. Each shared caregiver uses their own invited account through the Momcozy app.
Does BM08 include a physical parent monitor or support iPad viewing?
BM08 is designed to work through the Momcozy smartphone app. It does not include or support a separate physical display for this model, and the app is currently optimized for smartphones rather than iPad.
How can I save recordings locally?
A microSD card is recommended for local recordings. You can also save recordings to your phone manually; phone saving is not automatic.

I have not really gotten the breathing feature to fully work yet, but I also do not have mine mounted directly over his bed. I have it set across the room because my son is super handsy and would absolutely try to grab it if it was closer so that could definitely affect it.

Incredible tech
Ive tried a few monitors, and the BM08 is easily the most hightech one in the nursery right now from the ones Ive used. The big selling point for me was the contactfree vitals tracking. I hated the idea of strapping a sensor to my babys foot every night, and this uses radar tech to track breathing and heart rate from a distance. It actually works, though you have to be extremely precise with the camera placement to get a consistent reading.
Some positives
Insane Video Quality The 2K resolution is crystal clear. Even at 3 AM in total darkness, I can see if her eyes are actually closed or just squinting.
No Monthly Fees speaks for itself, you dont want to be stuck with a subscription after you paid a good bit for the hardware.
Smart Alerts The AI is surprisingly good at ignoring the ceiling fan or shadows and only pinging me for actual movement or cries.
Some Cons
AppOnly There is no handheld screen. If your phone dies or your WiFi glitches, youre flying blind. If you have spotty internet, maybe evaluate one with a screen This is not super bothersome for me, but I wanted to mention it
Setup If the baby moves to a weird corner of the crib, the breathing sensor sometimes loses the signal and sends a searching notification.
Overall, this is a go for me just from the standpoint of nothing that needs to be worn by my baby, getting notifications, and no false alarms. Im happy with this!
